description: This file defines a template class TraceType within the WPEFramework::Trace namespace, which implements tracing and logging control mechanisms. It includes nested classes for trace control, methods for enabling/disabling tracing, and macros for tracing. The file also references other internal components like ITraceControl, TraceUnit, and Module.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Trace::TraceType
classes.description: Template class implementing trace control and logging functionalities, including nested class TraceControl for managing individual trace categories and modules.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Trace::TraceType::TraceControl
classes.description: Nested class managing enable/disable state for specific trace categories and modules, including registration with TraceUnit.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Static method to check if tracing is enabled for the category.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Static method to enable or disable tracing for the category.

methods.name: Enabled (setter)
methods.description: Sets the enabled state for tracing.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Releases resources and unregisters trace control.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the trace data.
